description: This file defines a Go package 'operator' that implements a JSON-serializable Unix socket connection handler, 'JSONUnix', capable of sending and receiving JSON objects over a Unix domain socket with thread safety considerations. It provides methods for creating, sending, receiving, and closing such connections, handling message length deterministically using low-level syscall operations.

classes.name: JSONUnix
classes.description: A structure representing a JSON-serializable Unix socket connection, providing thread-safe send, receive, and close methods.

methods.name: NewJSONUnix
methods.description: Factory function that creates a new JSONUnix object from a given UnixConn, obtaining its RawConn for low-level syscall operations.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Serializes a Go value into JSON and transmits it over the Unix socket, ensuring thread safety with mutex locking.

methods.name: Recv
methods.description: Receives a JSON message from the Unix socket, reading the message length first and unmarshaling the JSON into the provided value.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the underlying Unix connection, ensuring thread safety.

methods.name: getNextMsgLen
methods.description: Uses syscall.RawConn to peek into the socket's buffer and determine the length of the next message using low-level recvfrom syscall.
